stable.title: DroidDeck 0.6.7
stable.summary: DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No source withheld.

recentPreviews.title: fix: a game with a launch-option picker is no longer closed while the picker is open (MK11)
recentPreviews.summary: Fixes the Discord report "MK11 won't run" (Mortal Kombat 11 on a RedMagic 11 Pro: it opens, then drops back to DroidDeck without booting, on 0.6.7 and every preview since).

recentPreviews.title: fix: library filter, sort and display menus aren't cut off in portrait
recentPreviews.summary: Fixes the Discord report "Library filter menus in portrait look weird, face wrong direction cut off".

recentPreviews.title: fix(audio): DirectAudio no longer crackles where Android refuses low-latency output
recentPreviews.summary: Fixes #1843 and #1819 (audio crackling and popping in Proton games with DirectAudio).

recentPreviews.title: feat: test and local builds show a faint PR, commit and title watermark
recentPreviews.summary:
• Test PR builds and local builds draw a small white-on-gray tag in the bottom-right corner of every activity (launcher, in-session menu, games, Steam, desktop), so a screenshot or screen share shows what build is running.
• PR builds: PR-1234 | abc1234 plus the PR title cut to 80 characters. Local builds: LOCAL | abc1234 plus the branch name.
• Stable and preview builds (CI builds without a PR nu

recentPreviews.title: feat: Steam's sleep-after timers start every session as Disabled
recentPreviews.summary:
• At every session start, before the Steam client launches, set Power > "Sleep after" (on battery and plugged in) to Disabled in each Steam home's config.vdf.
• Android owns the device's sleep; a client that suspends inside the session only shows a black screen that Android doesn't know about.
• Only IdleSuspendBatterySeconds and IdleSuspendACSeconds are forced. Dim display and screensaver timers

recentPreviews.title: fix: Steam's UI runs at the panel's full refresh rate again
recentPreviews.summary: Reported on Discord after the latest Preview: games run at 120 fps, but Steam Big Picture is locked at 60 on a 120 Hz screen, with power saving off and the vendor game manager disabled. Users expect the Steam UI to run at the panel's refresh rate, like games and the desktop do.

recentPreviews.title: fix: launching a game from a frontend starts it instead of sitting on the home screen
recentPreviews.summary: A game link (droiddeck://game/<id>, the LAUNCHGAME intent) sometimes left DroidDeck on its home screen with Play Steam until the user tapped.

recentPreviews.title: fix(runtime): cutscenes and in-game videos play again with DroidDeck-Proton (libva-drm2, libva-x11-2)
recentPreviews.summary: Fixes the 0.6.7 video regression reported on Discord (Video Playback Regression on 0.6.7, There some bugs on new Linux using DD proton, KH1.5+2.5 crashing at FMV cutscene).

recentPreviews.title: feat: cap the frame rate in session for games launched without Steam
recentPreviews.summary:
• Adds a Frame limit row to the in-session drawer's Display page for games launched without Steam (Off, 30, 40, 45, 60, 90, 120).
• The limit applies live: it paces the compositor and the display switches to a refresh rate the cap divides evenly, as the old Display setting did.
• It lasts for the session and resets when the next one starts. Steam games keep using Steam's Frame Limit in the Quick A

tests.title: Ask for All files access when a USB drive is mounted but unreadable
tests.summary: On some Samsung phones a USB drive shows up in the file manager but tapping it only shows "is mounted but not readable right now". Android mounts the drive but blocks DroidDeck from reading it until All files access is granted. The manifest already declares MANAGEEXTERNALSTORAGE, but DroidDeck never asked for it, so users had to find the setting themselves.

tests.title: fix: "DroidDeck isn't responding" on dual-screen handhelds after the bottom screen takes focus
tests.summary: Fixes "DroidDeck isn't responding" on the Retroid Pocket Duo when pressing RB/LB on the Stores tab (and other pages) after the bottom screen has taken focus.

tests.title: feat: the HUD is named DroidDeck HUD everywhere, without the credit line or the outline dot
tests.summary:
• Every HUD class, setting and label that said Fusion HUD now says DroidDeck HUD (DroidDeckHudView, DroidDeckHudHost, DroidDeckHudConfig, DroidDeckHudSettings, DroidDeckHudSize, and the HUD diagnostics report heading).
• The HUD page of the session menu no longer shows the FusionHUD / The412Banner credit line, and its hudcredit string is removed from every locale.
• The accent dot at the left edge of the HUD outline is gone; the outline is now only the neon stroke.

tests.title: ci: maintainer PR builds are release-signed as soon as the APK uploads
tests.summary: Cuts the time from push to a signed test build for same-repository PRs by about 4.5 minutes (roughly 18 to 13.5). Measured on recent runs, the Android unit tests (~3.1m) and lintVitalRelease (~1.2m) sat on the critical path before the APK upload, and signing then waited for the whole Build APK run to finish.

tests.title: Desktop: pacman, sudo, everyday utilities, copy/paste and touchpad-style touch gestures
tests.summary: The KDE desktop gets what a desktop needs: pacman that works, sudo, everyday utilities, working copy/cut/paste in Dolphin, and touch gestures for right-click and scrolling. It ships as desktop package desktop-kde-r3 (KDE Plasma with KWin 6.8.1).

tests.title: test: frame-order glitch on Adreno 740: order and producer-fence logging, draw on the tick
tests.summary: Diagnostic build, not for merge.

tests.title: Mali GPU support through MaliBridge by ASEbrahim
tests.summary: Brings MaliBridge by ASEbrahim into DroidDeck, along with ASEbrahim's DroidDeck integration from their fork, so phones with a Mali GPU can run sessions. The device is detected automatically: an Adreno keeps Turnip and the existing automatic driver route, and a Mali turns the bridge on.

tests.title: Temporary Game Jolt probe behind Debugging tools (not for merge)
tests.summary: not meant to be merged and is a debugging tool.

tests.title: feat(input): add native PS5 DualSense & DualSense Edge wireless/wired support
fix: a recreated launcher screen keeps running installs and save work busy
tests.summary: After the launcher screen is recreated (a language change, a settings reset, or a configuration change it doesn't handle), work that is still running stays marked busy. It is no longer possible to start a session or remove the Linux runtime while that work is writing into it.

tests.title: fix: a failing agent environment no longer blocks session start
tests.summary: Sessions now start even if the agent environment state can't be read or written.

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself; a crawling source is dropped for a faster one
tests.summary: Main already falls back from a client-update host that does not answer. It still starts with whichever one answers the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest. The install now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used. The x86-64 client's own install does th

tests.title: feat: add maintenance for other game stores
tests.summary: Installed games outside GOG lacked a consistent maintenance workflow. This adds metadata-only update checks and a compact Maintenance menu, pins queued targets to their existing installation folder, and preserves installation settings through maintenance and recovery.

tests.title: fix: keep 6+2 Oryon cores, Fold SoC names, and 120 Hz display mode across fold changes
tests.summary: Keep all 8 cores in programcores() on 6+2 Oryon SoCs (SM8750-AC / SM8850-AC), strip Samsung -AC/-AB SoC model suffixes in SocNames (alongside the canoe / Adreno 840 platform entries and a hex gpuchipid guard), and pin preferredDisplayModeId across fold/unfold configuration changes in PerfMode and SessionActivity.

tests.title: fix: duplicate cursors and clicks that miss in a game session
tests.summary: Problem. Input in a game session went wrong in several ways:

tests.title: fix: the virtual pads reach non-Steam programs, where udev is resolved through dlsym
tests.summary: Outside Steam the pads were invisible: Firefox and Chromium load libudev with dlopen and look the symbols up with dlsym, which skips interposition, so the browser found no pad even though the virtual device was there. SDL2 (SDLudev.c) and hidapi's Linux backend take the same route, so any program outside Steam that enumerates udev input devices missed them too.

tests.title: feat(input): make the controls toggle and keyboard buttons movable in the layout editor
tests.summary: The controls toggle and the keyboard button were drawn at fixed offsets from the screen corner, so the layout editor could not show or move them: they were not part of the control list, and their positions came from hardcoded insets.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: itch.io: install Linux builds and start them through Steam
tests.summary: Follow-up to #1503. Linux builds in the itch.io version picker, which were listed as "Not supported yet", can now be installed and started through Steam like every other game.

tests.title: debugging tool for a possible native Linux application launch
tests.summary: this is not meant to be merged and is only a debugging tool to get certain logs that I need

tests.title: Experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for the Linux runtime
tests.summary: This adds an experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for DroidDeck's Linux runtime. Steam, Proton and Linux apps can run on the phone's own Adreno Vulkan driver (or an imported AdrenoTools driver) instead of Turnip. Proton games, the Steam client and Zink-based OpenGL all present through it. The phone's system graphics stack is not modified and nothing needs root.

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
